verdict.rationale: Yubico positions the YubiKey itself as a hardware-backed passkey authenticator for passwordless login, and its 5.8 firmware brings smoother passkey UX. That implies device-bound discoverable credentials, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents resident-key storage or a username-less sign-in flow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of discoverable/resident credential storage, username-less WebAuthn sign-in flow, credential capacity/management details, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key stores discoverable FIDO2 credentials (resident keys / device-bound passkeys) so users can sign in to WebAuthn services without typing a username

citations.quote: phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication and passwordless login
YubiKey 5.8 is here — hardware signing, CTAP 2.3, and smoother passkey UX.
